title: Karbala Shrines & Drive to Najaf
full_text:
After breakfast, we will head to Karbala to visit the shrines of Imam Hussein and his brother Imam Alabbas.
We will enjoy the energy of the city during the day, having local food and sweets.
After that, we will drive to Najaf to check-in to the hotel and rest.
At night, we will visit the shrine of Imam Ali.
We will have Free time for shopping in the markets around the shrine.
If time permits, we will visit the “Valley of Peace”, the world’s largest cemetery.( optinal we can do it before check-in to the hotel or next day morning)
